__NOTOC__ [[File:Stone of Heroic Experience (2 million XP).png|300px|thumb|right|Stone of Heroic Experience]][[File:Stone of Epic Experience (2 million XP).png|300px|thumb|right|Stone of Epic Experience]][[File:Stone of Improved Epic Experience (2 million XP).png|300px|thumb|right|Stone of Improved Epic Experience]] A '''Stone of Experience''' is a special item that gives a character 2 million or 4 million [[experience point]]s without modifications. == Current versions == === {{Item|Heroic Otto's Irresistible Box}} & {{Item|Epic Otto's Irresistible Box}} === There are currently three versions of Otto's Irresistible Boxes and so there are three versions of Stones of Experience. {|class="wikitable" !Version||Base XP granted||Usage |- |Heroic||2,000,000||only on heroic levels, caps at maximum heroic XP |- |Epic||2,000,000||only on epic levels, caps at maximum epic XP |- |Improved Epic||4,000,000||only on epic levels, caps at maximum epic XP |} ''Base'' [[experience point]]s are affected by XP boosts (XP boost weekends only affect the VIP bonus). However, the heroic version hard cap at level 20, while the epic versions can only be taken after level 20 and hard cap at level 30. Further, only one stone can be used per life. === Usage === The Stones can be used on one's own character only. * To activate a Stone one oneself, one double-clicks it from inventory. * Stones can be mailed, traded, transmitted by shared bank but not sold to vendors nor auctioned. * Heroic Stones have no minimum level to activate. * Must be used in a public place. * {{Verified|While previously possible to apply the bonus to someone else by targeting them and activating the stone from a shortcut bar, this was likely a bug and it has been fixed.|by1=User:Joenuts on 2025/07/20}} === XP Math === Effects that increase the amount of incoming experience, such as {{Item|Voice of the Master}} or [[Experience Elixirs]], also increase the gained experience. Bonus weekend XP bonus has no effect, {{Verify| but additional VIP bonus XP may apply}}. {|class="wikitable" !Version||[[TR|Life]]||Starting XP||Base XP granted||Maximum XP gained||With 70% XP bonus applied * |- |rowspan="3"|Heroic||1–4 ||0||2,000,000||1,900,000 (cap)||1,900,000 (cap) |- |5–7 ||0|| 2,000,000 || 2,000,000 || 2,850,000 (cap) |- |8+||0|| 2,000,000 || 2,000,000 || 3,400,000 |- |Epic || — ||0||2,000,000|| 2,000,000||3,400,000 |- |Improved Epic || — ||0||4,000,000|| 4,000,000||6,800,000 |} {{*}} 50% XP Elixir, 10% [[VIP]] bonus, 5% [[Heroic Inspiration]] and 5% ship buff
== Historic Versions ==
While certain players may still have versions mentioned below, they are not attainable anymore in that form. === [[Menace of the Underdark]] bundle (January 2012, Level 8 to 16 version) === [[File:Stone of Experience.png||420px|thumb|right|MotU bundle Stone of Experience]] Players who purchased [[Menace of the Underdark]] and were level 16 or higher were eligible to receive Stones of Experience from a special NPC, Braddack Bouldershoulder, in [[the Harbor]] near [[the Marketplace]] entrance. This version of Stone of Experience could only be used once per account and [[servers|game server]]. Promotion ended upon the release of [[Update 15]]. At that time, all Stones of Experience were supposed to vanish (but some didn't, most notably the stones in Account Bank and TR cache). Players were granted stones based on their Menace of the Underdark purchase: * Base Edition = Two Stones * Standard Edition = Three Stones * Collector’s Edition = Five Stones Special conditions associated with the '''[[Menace of the Underdark]] bundle''' * The first time a Stone was used for another player, the owner received a bonus Stone through in-game mail. * The third time a Stone was used for another player, the owner received an exclusive Snow Panther cub [[creature companion]]. * Prior to [[Update 14]], Stones of Experience could be used on anyone of appropriate level met in public places, irrelevant to party membership. This caused much trouble among unaware players as some tried to distribute their Stones randomly just to get the Snow Panther cub. * The Stone could not be used on [[Druid]]s. Druids had just been introduced and had to progress through all levels normally. {{Quote |developer=Cordovan |date = 06-04-2012 |source = {{Forums|p=4498331|display=0}} |quote = The Stone of Shared Experience does not work on a Druid. }} {{Quote |developer=Vesuvium |date = 06-12-2012 |source = {{Forums|p=4517746|display=0}} |quote = Once you have used the Stone of Experience on a character, you cannot take Druid levels on that character.

This may change in the future though, possibly around the same time we start allowing people to veteran status into Druid, or LR into Druid levels. }} === {{Item|Otto's Irresistible Box (history)}} (December 2012, Level 8 to 16 version) === Stones of Experience temporarily returned to the game as part of a limited time [[DDO Store]] item package. One Stone was included in each box. Some problems involving their use were remedied by the [[Update 16 Patch 1 Hotfix Release Notes|Update 16 Patch 1 Hotfix]]. The stones can be traded, however, only the person who opens the box can actually use the stone (on own character or a different one). {{Quote |source = {{Forums|p=4816862|display=0}} |developer=QuartermasterX |date = 12-17-2012 |quote = The stone of experience from the Holiday Box can indeed be used by characters who have previously true reincarnated or used a stone of experience before. }} === {{Item|Bigby's Handy Box}} (July 2013, Level 7 to 15 version) === These new stones are BtA, not affected by XP bonuses as old stones are, and are not usable on other characters as old stones are: '''SELF USE ONLY'''.{{Quote |source = {{Forums|p=5033903|display=0}} |developer=Cordovan |date = 07-03-2013 |quote = Bonus sources of XP do not stack with the Stone of Experience provided in the Bigby's Handy Box. }} === XP Math === * The XP granted is what is necessary to reach the target level from the character's current XP, i.e., the character benefits most from using the Stone just after reaching the minimum level. * The [[reincarnation|TR]] status is considered, i.e., the amount of XP granted is higher on characters in their second, third, or subsequent life. * Effects that increase the amount of incoming experience, such as {{Item|Voice of the Master}} or [[Experience Elixirs]], increase the level 16 version Stone's benefit ({{Forums|p=5061127|confirmed to be WAI}}).
